title: 🔆🔅TEHRAN, Oct. 19, 2026 — Iran’s Armed Forces Chief of Staff, Maj. Gen. Ali Abdollahi, made some remarks in an interview.
text:
🔆🔅TEHRAN, Oct. 19, 2026 — Iran’s Armed Forces Chief of Staff, Maj. Gen. Ali Abdollahi, made some remarks in an interview."

""
"SOT, Major General Ali Abdollahi, Chief of Staff of Iran's Armed Forces (Farsi): “America is no longer the powerful America it once claimed to be. American power has aged; after all, everything has a lifespan, and we are now in the era of America’s declining power. Trump keeps threatening, ‘I will do this.’ Rest assured, he has done everything he could, but he failed, and he will not succeed in the future either. There is no doubt about this.”
